items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1974-03-28
items.q: The name 'Clive Wilson' is mentioned by the [INTERVIEWER] to identify the person in the room or on the recording, but the [INTERVIEWEE] does not mention Clive Wilson in their speech, nor does the interviewee respond to the name with any personal anecdote or relationship description.

ctx.x: Oh, well, we did the recording, and before we could release the things, he died. I mean, I think that was good. I think that was during the time, Bessie, that storm came up there, and just straw, you know, plenty of different things he had, little property and all that. And after that, the man, wife quit him and everything. And when I heard from McGinney was dead.
Yeah. Now, uh, Clive, what's your name, anyway? I just want to see if he's picking you up.
